name: 登録した支払い方法の初期設定と削除の管理欄
prompt:
Create a faithful Japanese-localized saved-payment-method row based on the supplied references. Use the original crop as the authority for the wide row layout and control placement; use the Japanese preview for the exact wording and the explicitly hidden card suffix. Output one clean white component at approximately 682×132 proportions (about 5.17:1), without broad blank bands, extra rows, or additional payment details.

On the left, reproduce the stacked text hierarchy: bold 「カード・末尾は非表示」, then 「カード」, then 「12月・2027年」. Keep the card suffix hidden; do not infer or invent any digits. On the right, align a quiet light-gray rounded status pill labeled 「初期設定」 next to a compact outlined square delete button with a simple trash-can icon. Along the bottom left, include the muted note 「今後の支払いには、この方法が使用されます。」 in the restrained small-text style of the Japanese preview. Preserve generous horizontal spacing, compact vertical rhythm, subtle neutral styling, and crisp Japanese sans-serif text. Do not add a card-network logo, actual card number, extra controls, or any wording beyond the specified Japanese text.
reviewNotes: Registered v001 with stored:true and catalogUpdated:true. The candidate preserves the hidden card suffix and Japanese text, but its 2018x779 (2.591:1) canvas is substantially taller than the 682x132 original crop (5.167:1) and 560x140 mock (4.000:1), leaving broad blank space; needs-correction. SHA-256 matches manifest/catalog; metadata includes prompt/references; HTML entry and stored image were checked.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
